mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases over 6 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY growth > 5% and RSAFS YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: If both HOUST and RSAFS meet the growth criteria and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% over the past month, it signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the criteria and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) also increases by more than 2% YoY, it signals a strong supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and GDPC1 meet the growth criteria and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
